topic: How to book online in under a minute

slides.headline: Booking with us takes about a minute
slides.sub: A quick walkthrough of booking online, step by step.

slides.title: Step 1: tap the link in bio
slides.body: Head to @hybrid_physio_sydney and tap the booking link. It opens our online booking page, where you can see available times without needing to call or wait on hold.

slides.title: Step 2: choose your clinic
slides.body: Pick Chatswood (Level 1, 38B Albert Ave) or Sydney CBD (Suite 1102, 99 York St). Choose whichever is easier to get to from home or work.

slides.title: Step 3: pick service and visit type
slides.body: Choose physio, chiro, clinical Pilates or remedial massage, then an initial or follow-up appointment. If it's your first visit for this problem, an initial appointment is usually the right pick.

slides.title: Step 4: pick a time and confirm
slides.body: Choose a practitioner and time that suit you, add your details and confirm. You'll receive a confirmation with the time and address, so it's easy to find again.

slides.title: Not sure which service to choose?
slides.body: That's common. Give the clinic a call or send us a message and our admin team can help you work out where to start. We refer between services when that helps.

slides.headline: Your next visit, one minute away
slides.body: Tap the link in bio, choose your clinic and service, then pick a time. Chatswood and Sydney CBD.

caption:
Booking an appointment shouldn't take longer than the appointment reminder.

Here's the quick version: tap the link in our bio, choose Chatswood or Sydney CBD, pick physio, chiro, clinical Pilates or remedial massage, then an initial or follow-up visit. Choose a time that suits, add your details and confirm. You'll get a confirmation with the time and address.

If it's your first visit for a new problem, an initial appointment is usually the right choice. Not sure which service fits? Give the clinic a call or send us a message and our admin team will help you work it out.

Book online via the link in bio.

General information only — not a substitute for an individual assessment.
